messages:
Priya Shah: Quick sync — want to run a 90-min Solution Architect Handoff workshop for new SI partners next Wed. Goal: baseline configs, cert checklist, two hands-on labs. Anyone free to co-host?
Alex Kim: I'm in. Can we keep it under 1.5h? Suggest hands-on lab on Dedicated capacity + Marketplace SKU mapping.
Daniel Ruiz: I'll cover runtime/deployment slides and demo private deploy. Need a lab VM + sample config.
Lina Torres: I can own the lab instructions + Terraform snippets. Will draft by EOD Fri. Any preference for model & dataset?
Priya Shah: Prefer an open-model small LLM and a tiny conversational dataset. @OnboardBot can you create a calendar event when we lock time?
OnboardBot: Event created: Solution Architect Handoff — Wed 10:00–11:30 PT. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123
Alex Kim: Agenda proposal:
```
10:00–10:10 Intro + objectives
10:10–10:30 Runtime architecture & best practices
10:30–11:00 Lab 1: Dedicated capacity + SKU mapping (hands-on)
11:00–11:20 Lab 2: Private deploy + KMS (hands-on)
11:20–11:30 Q&A + cert next steps
```
Thoughts?
Daniel Ruiz: Looks good. Can we add a short section on fallback routing policies and multi-region failover? Customers ask about that all the time. :+1:
Priya Shah: Yes. Also want to confirm certification gating: require passing the hands-on labs + a short quiz. Proposed threshold: 80%.
Lina Torres: Quiz ideas: explain autoscaling policy config, list required IAM roles for private deploy, and write a curl to call the hosted API with streaming. I'll add these to the draft.
Alex Kim: Also let's create a one-pager 'SI quickstart' for SEs — top-5 troubleshooting steps and commands. I'll draft layout.
Daniel Ruiz: I'll add a troubleshooting snippet to the doc: `runtimes logs tail --env prod --model rdx-small` and a note about QPS throttling and backpressure.
Priya Shah: Decision: move forward with Wed 10:00. Lina to post lab doc by Fri EOD. Alex & Daniel to co-host. I'll follow up with invite to the SI cohort and certification link. :rocket:
OnboardBot: Reminder set for 24h before event.
Alex Kim: I'll loop in marketing for a joint announcement template if an SI completes certification by EOW; that could help partner momentum.
